title: Spinach & Cheese Scrambled Eggs
description: Soft scrambled eggs with spinach and melted cheese.

steps.text: Melt 1 teaspoon butter in a nonstick skillet and wilt 1 cup spinach for about 1 minute.
Pour in eggs and stir gently over medium-low heat until softly set, about 3–4 minutes.
Fold in 1/2 cup shredded cheese and remove from heat.

title: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Orzo
description: A one-pot creamy orzo side or light meal.

steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a saucepan and cook 2 minced garlic cloves for 30 seconds.
Stir in 1 cup orzo and 2 cups broth. Bring to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 10–12 minutes, stirring often, until orzo is tender and most liquid is absorbed.
Stir in 1/2 cup Parmesan and 1/4 cup milk until creamy.

title: Lemon Butter Peas & Rice
description: Bright buttery rice with peas, useful as a side or simple meal.

steps.text: Combine 1 cup rice and 2 cups water or broth in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Cover, lower heat, and cook 15 minutes.
Add 1 cup frozen peas on top, cover again, and cook 3 minutes.
Fluff with 2 tablespoons butter and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.

title: Crispy Parmesan Roasted Cabbage
description: Roasted cabbage with crisp edges and Parmesan.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut 1/2 large cabbage into thick wedges or slabs.
Brush cabbage with 2 tablespoons olive oil and season with 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Roast 20 minutes, flip carefully, and sprinkle with 1/2 cup Parmesan.
Roast 8–10 minutes more until browned at the edges.
